Events of a native log that a longer gap in ingestion lets the agent tool delete are lost, and a purge that names a corrected version brings back only events whose native log still exists.
A longer retention period is advised: change the setting beside each agent tool. Its cost: the native log keeps the text of prompts, responses, and code on the disk for longer.
